Remark
[unbounded Sobolev--Poincaré constants]

Source: petersen:page-0323 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-poincare-sobolev 1. ch7:7.5.7Construct convex surfaces in $\mathbb {R}^3$ by capping off cylinders $[-R,R]\times S^1$ to show the Sobolev--Poincaré constants increase as $R$ increases. (Hint: consider test functions constant except on $[-1,1]\times S^1$.)
